text: {"evidencePatch":{"proposal_sha256":"f1bb189a97cb5844c571890905c12f375fa89102531a29dcbbb05a7e514aeb9b","replacements":[{"path":"/topics","value":{"terms":["妊娠期糖尿病","妊娠期内分泌疾病","骨质疏松与代谢性骨病","女性内分泌健康","糖尿病","非典型股骨骨折","糖皮质激素诱发高血糖"],"explanation":"综述范围严格限定于两个证据来源:(1) Alfred Health 官方 Find a doctor 目录中明确列出的 Sztal-Mazer 医生所任职的专科门诊——Gestational Diabetes & Endocrine Disease in Pregnancy Clinic、Osteoporosis and Metabolic Bone Clinic、Women's Endocrinology Health Clinic 与 Diabetes Clinic;(2) 经作者归属核实的自著论文标题所显示的具体研究主题——非典型股骨骨折(TrAFFiC 队列研究)与泼尼松龙诱发高血糖的治疗。所有主题术语均与上述来源文字一一对应,不含仅由领域文献推导的术语。","citations":[{"sourceId":"src_2493de44f6d829d4a438c889950665fe","quote":"Dr Shoshana Sztal-Mazer | Endocrinology | Endocrinology Clinic - Gestational Diabetes & Endocrine Disease in Pregnancy , Osteoporosis and Metabolic Bone Clinic , Women's Endocrinology Health Clinic , Diabetes Clinic , Endocrinology Clinic"},{"sourceId":"src_pubmed_41989128","passageId":"title","quote":"Asian ethnicity is associated with shorter anti-resorptive exposure prior to atypical femur fracture (AFF): a Transcontinental Atypical Femoral Fracture Consortium (TrAFFiC) cohort study."},{"sourceId":"src_pubmed_36880383","passageId":"title","quote":"Mixed insulin can improve control of prednisolone-induced hyperglycaemia."}]}}]}}
